summary: Full backend + frontend regression on CARI KROTO MVP. Backend: 12/12 pytest cases passed via public EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL, covering locations CRUD, visit create/edit/delete with aggregate recompute (visit_count, total_harvest_kg, last_visit_at, next_harvest_at, status flip to cooldown), photo upload/serve/delete, and soft-delete cascade. Frontend: web preview loads without red screen; bottom tabs (Peta/Daftar/Jadwal/Atur) navigate; header shows counts; map-type toggle and recenter render; 'Tandai Lokasi' FAB opens add-location screen (add-location-screen testID), prefilled coords, save creates location and returns home with count updated to '1 lokasi · 1 siap panen'. Daftar tab lists card, search filter and 3 sort chips (ready/recent/name) work, card tap navigates to /location/{id} (detail-screen). Detail shows Jadwal panen countdown, Total panen, Kunjungan count, catatan, Foto Pohon, Riwayat Kunjungan section. 'Catat Panen' opens Log screen (log-harvest-screen) with input-amount/input-visit-notes, save-visit-btn persists visit; on return detail shows '2,5 kg / 1x / Masa Tunggu' status flip and visit row with visit-edit/visit-delete testIDs. Settings theme selector switches modes (dark/light/system) and persists via useThemeMode.

minor.issue: LocationUpdate uses `payload.dict()` (deprecated in Pydantic v2, should be model_dump); also updates dict filters None but allows empty strings which is fine. Cosmetic only.

issues: Fixed-bottom 'Catat Panen' button overlaps the bottom tab bar area on small viewport (390x844) — tabs still reachable but visually stacked. Consider adding bottom padding equal to tab height, or hide tab bar on this stack screen.

react_native_issues.issue: Uses deprecated `pointerEvents` prop on View — console warns 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/index.tsx:118

Uses deprecated `shadow*` style props ('shadow*' style props are deprecated. Use 'boxShadow' in React Native Web/0.76+). Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/index.tsx (headerCard, controlBtn, fab) and likely other components.

Web warning: 'Listening to push token changes is not yet fully supported on web. Adding a listener will have no effect.' Native only; wrap listener registration in `if (Platform.OS !== 'web')` to silence.
Warning: 'Animated: `useNativeDriver` is not supported because the native animated module is missing.' Web-only cosmetic; consider setting useNativeDriver:false on web or gate the animation.

action_items: Replace `pointerEvents="box-none"` prop with style.pointerEvents on the floating header View in app/(tabs)/index.tsx:118 (and any similar usages).
Migrate shadow* style props to `boxShadow` (or keep for iOS/Android and guard for web) in FAB, header card, control buttons and shared components.
Gate expo-notifications listener setup so it is only registered when Platform.OS !== 'web'.
Optional: switch backend Pydantic v1 `.dict()` calls to `.model_dump()` in server.py update endpoints.
Optional UX: on the location detail screen, add bottom padding equal to bottom tab bar height so the 'Catat Panen' button doesn't overlap the tab bar visually on web.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py correctly excludes MongoDB _id from responses via location_doc_to_api / visit_doc_to_api mappers — good.
Aggregation on visit CRUD is done with $inc atomic ops on Mongo — correct and race-safe for single-user app.
Soft-delete cascade of visits when a location is deleted is implemented — matches spec.
No auth as per spec; OWNER_ID hardcoded to 'default' — acceptable for MVP.
Frontend uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL correctly, no hardcoded URLs found in tested screens.
Interactive elements (FAB, controls, cards, chips, tabs, save buttons, visit rows) all have testID attributes — testability is excellent.
seed_data_creation: Test data created and cleaned up by tests (TEST_ prefix). UI test location also deleted via DELETE /api/locations/{id}.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite in /app/backend/tests/ (pytest, 12 cases) — run with `pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v` against EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Frontend web preview supports full flow: Tandai Lokasi -> add-location-screen (input-name, input-notes, interval-{3|7|14|21|30}, save-location-btn) -> back to map; Daftar (location-card-{id}, sort-chip-{ready|recent|name}, search-input) -> Detail (detail-screen, detail-edit, detail-delete, record-harvest-btn) -> Log (log-harvest-screen, input-amount, input-visit-notes, save-visit-btn). Native-only features (real map, GPS, camera, notifications) intentionally not testable on web and should NOT be flagged as bugs.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no functional bugs found. Only React Native web deprecation warnings and one minor overlap on detail screen tab bar.
